rule: GOAL: Match the target color sequence shown at the top by filling the middle slots in order. CONTROLS: Click a color in the bottom palette to select it, then click a middle slot to place it. RULE: Each placed color consumes one step from the shrinking bar, so plan your sequence carefully. TRAP: Believing selecting a color counts as a step wastes time; only placing a color reduces your budget.

GOAL: Guide the player from the start to the exit marker on the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one cell in that direction. RULE: You can only enter white cells; gray and black cells are impassable walls. TRAP: Assuming you can slide through gray cells to reach white ones wastes moves, as gray blocks passage entirely.

GOAL: Align the gray boundary with the yellow marker in the black bar. CONTROLS: Click blue squares to shift the gray region's edge position. RULE: Each click moves the boundary by four columns, allowing precise alignment. TRAP: Assuming the keyhole needed to touch the marker wasted time; only the main wall mattered.

GOAL: Drop the ball into the target notch. CONTROLS: Arrows move the paddle; spacebar releases the ball. RULE: The paddle must be positioned directly under the ball to guide it correctly. TRAP: Thinking the paddle blocks the ball; it actually splashes and fails the level if hit.

GOAL: Move the purple square to touch the blue circle. CONTROLS: Click a destination to slide the square up to six squares in any direction. RULE: Completion triggers when the square becomes adjacent to the circle, not inside it. TRAP: Do not try to place the square inside the blue circle; it only completes when touching the edge.

GOAL: Match the first mismatching pair to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click to place items. Space to run the scan animation. RULE: The scan checks pairs in order and stops at the first mismatch. TRAP: Assuming all pairs are checked. The scan halts immediately upon finding a mismatch.

GOAL: Toggle T-glyphs to match the target pattern using three precise clicks. CONTROLS: Clicking a glyph flips its top and bottom segments simultaneously. RULE: Each click acts as a strict toggle; clicking the same glyph twice restores its original state. TRAP: Assuming clicks were directional or cumulative rather than simple binary flips wasted time on complex sequences.

GOAL: Align the green marker with the keyhole by moving the lower bar. CONTROLS: Top buttons shift the middle section; bottom buttons move the lower bar. RULE: The lower bar’s position depends strictly on the middle section’s location. TRAP: Thinking the bottom buttons move the bar independently wastes time; adjust the middle section first.

GOAL: Match colored shapes to empty slots by following a connected path through the boxes. CONTROLS: Click shapes to select, click slots to place, press space to submit. RULE: Shapes must fill slots in a continuous sequence, flowing from the first box through the connecting pipe to the second box. TRAP: Assuming slots fill independently by color alone, ignoring the mandatory path order that links the boxes together.

GOAL: Arrange colors to match a specific reading order. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click slots to place, press space to verify. RULE: The ring acts as a break in the sequence, separating the main line from the attached box. TRAP: Thinking the ring is a regular color piece to be counted in the target list.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens to form the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette to select, click slot to place, space to submit. RULE: The ring marks where the secondary box’s contents insert into the main row. TRAP: Assuming the ring is decorative; missing its placement breaks the sequence order.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding a lethal guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player one step. RULE: The guard lunged two spaces toward you only if you ended your turn in its row. TRAP: Thinking vertical entry into the guard's column was safe; it still triggered the fatal horizontal lunge.

GOAL: Place six solid colors and two rings to match a hidden target sequence containing a repeated three-color block. CONTROLS: Click palette items to fill red slots or blue ring blocks; click rings to place them; press space to verify. RULE: The blue box reveals a three-color pattern that must appear identically twice in the final sequence. TRAP: Assuming rings can be spaced apart; the matching block positions forced the rings to be adjacent.

ESTABLISHED: The creature is at the bottom right. A dropped box blocks the far right column. Slot one is at the top left. FAILED: Moving the module right from the creature's left side is impossible because the body hits the dropped box before the module reaches the slot. GOAL IS NOT: Attaching the module from the left or pushing it through the right side of the grid. CONTROLS: Arrows move the body. Space attaches or drops the module. The creature must approach the slot from the left, facing right.

ESTABLISHED: The four-cell diamond pattern is the target. Pressing the reference panel correctly sets the plunger to this pattern. FAILED: Clicking the four diamond cells with the plunger in its default orientation only triggers a temporary flash and resets the grid to blank. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the visual pattern on the grid without regard for the plunger's physical orientation or direction. CONTROLS: Up and Down buttons rotate the plunger tip; clicking grid cells stamps the current plunger pattern onto the board.

GOAL: Move the attached block into the target slot. CONTROLS: Arrows move the body; Space attaches or drops the block. RULE: The block follows the body's path, occupying the previous position. TRAP: Moving the body directly over the block fails; you must attach it first.

GOAL: Raise three blocks to specific heights using ten moves. CONTROLS: Each button moves two adjacent blocks in opposite directions. RULE: Blocks stop rising if they hit the lower of any neighboring barrier. TRAP: Assuming blocks can pass through barriers to reach higher targets wastes time.

ESTABLISHED: Pink shapes are symmetrized blue shapes. Rotated pink variants exist in the selection cycle. FAILED: Simple unions of blue with its mirrors or rotations. Filling holes. Basic dilation. GOAL IS NOT: Just matching pixel counts. Ignoring rotation. Selecting the raw blue shape. CONTROLS: Cycle through options to find the pink shape that matches the blue shape’s specific rotation and symmetrization rule.

GOAL: Arrange colored rings in the top box to reveal a hidden sequence of nine items below. CONTROLS: Click to move rings and solid tokens into empty slots. Press Space to confirm your arrangement. RULE: Each ring reveals the three items stored in its matching colored container, appearing in left-to-right order. TRAP: Assuming rings change item values; they only determine which container’s contents appear, so match the first item of each group carefully.

ESTABLISHED: The head moves in six-row increments. Its lowest position is row 18, not row 12. The tail extends downward from the head. FAILED: Attempting to push the right block down from rows 13-16. The head cannot reach high enough to contact it. GOAL IS NOT: Placing the right block in the lower tail path. It is permanently stuck in its upper position. CONTROLS: UP moves the head up six rows. DOWN moves the head down six rows. The tail follows the head's movement.

GOAL: Place the yellow square on the target circle. CONTROLS: Clicking moves the active piece toward that spot. RULE: The piece lands with its center near the click location. TRAP: Thinking you need to merge pieces again; simply move the built square to the goal.

GOAL: Match each slot's pink shape to the correct target family using only five moves. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows move the selection cursor; Up and Down arrows rotate the active shape. RULE: Shapes cycle through a fixed family order, so rotating one step forward often solves a slot instantly. TRAP: Assuming you must rotate downward; trying to go the long way around wastes moves when a single upward click fixes the mismatch.

GOAL: Reach the exit while navigating a grid of stationary enemies with fixed facing directions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in the cardinal direction. RULE: Enemies attack only if the player enters their line of sight within range two, after the player moves. TRAP: Assuming safe distance applies if you enter an enemy's line at range three; this triggers an immediate fatal lunge.

GOAL: Align yellow and blue crosses to cover all matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross three steps per press. Space toggles control between colors. RULE: The cross center must sit exactly at the intersection of the target dots’ shared row and column. TRAP: Assuming arm length stays full when near edges. Lines clip at board borders, but still cover targets if aligned.

GOAL: Align three shifting shapes over their matching dot clusters to clear the board. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; spacebar cycles to the next shape in the sequence. RULE: Each shape covers dots within its specific reach; only the selected shape responds to movement. TRAP: Assuming you can move shapes independently; you must cycle through them to position each one correctly.

GOAL: Grow a bar until its red dot lands exactly on the target cross. CONTROLS: Click the bottom compartment to extend the bar’s length by three units. RULE: The level clears only when the dot covers the cross’s center pixel. TRAP: Aligning the bar’s edge with the cross is not enough; the dot must overlap the center.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to place the unique yellow block onto the marked corner slot. CONTROLS: The red arrow rotates the ring one step clockwise; the green arrow rotates it counter-clockwise. RULE: Only the single yellow block matters; all other colors are distractions. TRAP: Assuming you need to align multiple colors or match the arrow's color with the block.

GOAL: Place the bead on the target ring. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move the white end; click the gray end to swap it with the white end. RULE: The bead always sits at the exact midpoint between the gray and white ends. TRAP: Believing the gray end is fixed; you must swap it to reposition the anchor and reach the target.

GOAL: Cover all marked dots using three distinct shapes. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; Space switches to the next shape in the cycle. RULE: The level ends only when every dot is hidden beneath a shape’s pixels. TRAP: Assuming shapes must be placed in a specific order; they can be moved independently, but placing the final piece last avoids premature checks.

GOAL: Transform the active grid to match the hidden target pattern. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle their color state. RULE: Blue cells become gray, and red cells become white. TRAP: Assuming the center mini-pattern was a static label rather than the actual goal to replicate.

GOAL: Clear the board by leaving only one peg standing. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the empty landing spot to jump over the adjacent peg and capture it. RULE: You can only jump over a neighboring peg into an empty space directly beyond it; the jumped peg is removed. TRAP: Selecting a peg is a separate click from moving it; clicking the landing spot without first selecting the moving peg does nothing.

GOAL: Replicate the mini patterns onto the main grid using the active color. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color to match the pattern. RULE: The mini's center color indicates which hue to use for the painted cells. TRAP: Assuming the mini's white cells meant "leave blank" rather than "paint active."

GOAL: Match the pattern shown on the screen, then push the block into the glowing dock. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one step per press, rotating its shape or sliding it along the floor. RULE: The block must face the exact same way as the target symbol before entering the dock area. TRAP: Thinking you can dock from any direction; the block’s orientation must align perfectly or the move fails.

GOAL: Extend four colored bars to precise target lengths to unlock the level. CONTROLS: Click specific side buttons to grow or shrink each colored bar individually. RULE: Each bar moves one unit per click, requiring exact counts to align with hidden targets. TRAP: Assuming clicks always register; blocked moves due to collisions caused stale errors and wasted time.

GOAL: Align the yellow tokens onto the fixed X markers. CONTROLS: Clicking a ring or row rotates its cells one step backward. RULE: Each rotation shifts every item in that line to the previous position. TRAP: Assuming X markers move with the rings, when they are actually fixed anchors.

GOAL: Paint specific cells orange to match hidden patterns projected by four mini-games. CONTROLS: Click a cell to toggle its color between orange and red. RULE: White subcells in a mini match the mini's center color; green subcells show the opposite. TRAP: Assuming all minis share the same "on" color, ignoring that some have inverted centers.

ESTABLISHED: Two blue blocks move in five-unit hops. The maze has a top corridor and open lower sections. No hazards exist. FAILED: Moving both blocks to the top corridor ends failed. Moving them adjacent failed. Random wandering without a specific configuration failed. GOAL IS NOT: Reaching the top corridor ends. Making the blocks touch. Simply visiting specific coordinates. CONTROLS: LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN move the active block one hop.

GOAL: Recolor all grid cells to satisfy the hidden color constraints of the scattered markers. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell cycles its color through blue, red, and orange in that fixed order. RULE: A marker’s surrounding ring must display the specific color opposite to the marker’s center color. TRAP: Assuming any non-center color works for the ring; only the one specific opposite color satisfies the puzzle.

GOAL: Guide yellow and orange pieces to matching markers on opposite rings. CONTROLS: Red buttons rotate the right ring; green buttons rotate the left ring. RULE: Pieces transfer between rings only when passing through the two shared intersection cells. TRAP: Assuming pieces are locked to their starting ring; they can cross if rotated during overlap.

ESTABLISHED: The ball is immovable by the paddle. The paddle moves freely in the left room and corridor. FAILED: Moving the paddle left into the ring's interior using standard collision assumptions; the ring walls block entry. GOAL IS NOT: Pushing the ball into the ring or scoring a point via ball contact. CONTROLS: Directional keys move the paddle three cells per press; collision checks likely use a narrow center-column footprint rather than the full sprite box.

ESTABLISHED: The player starts at (8,14). The plug retracts only when the player reaches the socket at (8,38). The bottom bar decreases with each action, indicating a strict step limit. FAILED: Walking to the plug at (38,14) does nothing. Pushing the plug from above or below fails. Pressing SPACE at the plug location has no effect. GOAL IS NOT: Touching the plug to trigger a win. The plug is a passive object, not a key to be grabbed or pushed. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one grid step. SPACE triggers a rewind or reset, but does not interact with objects.

GOAL: Slide two blocks into marked slots using global shifts. CONTROLS: Click arrows to shift all blocks in that direction. RULE: Every block moves simultaneously; paths must not collide. TRAP: Thinking only the clicked block moves; ignoring shared space causes jams.

GOAL: Move the bead to the target ring. CONTROLS: Click three spots to place markers. RULE: The bead moves to the average position of the three markers. TRAP: Thinking you can place markers freely; the bead must not overlap obstacles during the move.

GOAL: Cover both yellow markers with yellow blocks. CONTROLS: Top arrows rotate the top row; middle arrows rotate the long serpentine path. RULE: The top row is part of the serpentine, so moves interact on shared cells. TRAP: Assuming the two arrow pairs act on completely separate, independent groups.

GOAL: Clear the grid by turning all cells to their target color within a click limit. CONTROLS: Clicking a normal cell toggles it and its orthogonal neighbors; clicking a special cell toggles a wider cross pattern. RULE: Special cells affect mini-cells, which must be accounted for in the toggle logic to avoid parity errors. TRAP: Assuming mini-cells are immune to toggles from adjacent specials leads to unsolvable states and wasted clicks.

GOAL: Route the token through two separate rings to complete their respective paths. CONTROLS: Click to swap the token with a ring piece, or click a piece to move it. RULE: Work one ring completely while using the other ring’s initial positions as static obstacles. TRAP: Assuming you can interleave moves freely; you must fully clear one ring before starting the other to avoid blocking paths.

GOAL: Reach the yellow tile. CONTROLS: Arrows move the green block; clicks toggle red and blue barriers. RULE: Red and blue blocks swap positions when their respective plugs are clicked. TRAP: Believing dark red was a wall, when it is actually walkable floor.

GOAL: Align the reflected piece with the target shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move the main piece; its mirror image follows automatically. RULE: The reflection mirrors your position across a fixed vertical axis. TRAP: Assuming you could move the reflection independently, when only the original piece responds to inputs.

GOAL: Transport the merged shapes to the two designated target zones. CONTROLS: Each click moves a shape directly toward your cursor position. RULE: Shapes travel only if your click lands within a specific radius of their edge. TRAP: Clicking far away does nothing; you must step closer to pull the shape along its path.

GOAL: Rotate the plug so its prongs face the socket, then slide it into place. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the plug; other keys move it across the grid. RULE: Only the correct rotation aligns the prongs with the socket’s tabs. TRAP: Moving before rotating wastes time, as the wrong orientation blocks insertion.

GOAL: Reach the exit without touching the patrolling guard or its path. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step per press. RULE: The guard moves two cells each turn; if blocked, it reverses direction. TRAP: Assuming the guard stays still or moves only one step, leading to fatal collisions.

GOAL: Place two specific tiles to complete the ring sum. CONTROLS: Click a tile to place it; click again to remove it. RULE: The sum of row and column indices for all placed tiles must match the ring numbers. TRAP: Assuming any valid pair works; only the specific coordinate sum matters, not the tile type.

GOAL: Rotate snowflake arms to match target colors. CONTROLS: Click arms to rotate them clockwise or counter-clockwise. RULE: Only the three marked arms with tips can be moved. TRAP: Assuming all eight arms are movable wastes clicks on locked sections.

GOAL: Merge eight scattered dots into one large block and deliver it to the target circle. CONTROLS: Clicking near a cluster pulls it toward the cursor or merges adjacent clusters into a larger shape. RULE: Clicks only affect clusters within a specific radius, allowing you to isolate and move specific groups. TRAP: Assuming clusters stay still; they shift significantly with each pull, requiring constant distance checks before merging.

GOAL: Lower the right platform to unblock the passage, transfer the key, then raise it to align with the target. CONTROLS: Right arrows move weight right, lowering the left platform and raising the right. Clicking an orange window moves the key. RULE: The window only opens when the opposite platform is low enough to leave the path clear. TRAP: Assuming the key could cross while the destination platform was high blocked progress; you must lower the blocker first.

GOAL: Navigate to the green target while avoiding orange hazards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one square at a time. RULE: Enemies move only when you move, allowing you to time your steps. TRAP: Assuming you can swap places with an enemy is fatal; never enter their current square.

GOAL: Align the reflection with the target zone by shifting the mirror, then lower the piece into place. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; Space switches focus between the piece and the mirror. RULE: Moving the mirror shifts the reflection twice as far, allowing precise horizontal alignment. TRAP: Trying to align the reflection by moving the piece horizontally fails due to board boundaries.

GOAL: Route yellow tokens to target slots using intersecting horizontal and vertical tracks. CONTROLS: Green arrows shift values up; red arrows shift down; side buttons rotate horizontal and block tracks simultaneously. RULE: Vertical and horizontal movements are independent, allowing you to park a token off the main line to adjust its position without disturbing others. TRAP: Assuming vertical and horizontal rotations share a common cycle; treating them as separate systems saves critical actions by allowing independent positioning.

ESTABLISHED: The pod is at column 45. Water starts at column 31. The current screen shows green blocks at columns 13-29. FAILED: Aligning the stored map rows with the current frame's pixel data; the map shows green at 19-35, creating a mismatch. GOAL IS NOT: A simple coordinate shift between the camera and the grid; the discrepancy is internal to the data structure. CONTROLS: Navigation moves the pod. The camera follows the pod. The map updates based on camera position, not raw screen pixels.

GOAL: Guide the green block to the yellow square. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the block; clicks rotated colored arms. RULE: Arms must align to form a continuous path; only connected tiles allow movement. TRAP: Assuming all red segments were passable; dark red hubs blocked the direct vertical route.

GOAL: Position two shapes so their mirror reflections perfectly overlay the target yellow patterns. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; SPACE cycles selection between the mirror and each shape. RULE: Reflections flip vertically across the mirror line; align the reflected shape, not the direct one. TRAP: Moving the mirror instead of the shape wastes actions; lock the mirror’s position first.

ESTABLISHED: The canvas has purple rows 34-38 and a bottom-left purple triangle. FAILED: Painting rows 34-38 purple, creating SE or SW triangle patterns, and making the canvas uniform white did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the preview image, achieving a uniform canvas color, or filling specific rows. CONTROLS: Selecting swatches sets the paint color. Rotating changes the dip orientation. Pressing SPACE dips the frame to transfer color.

GOAL: Align two shapes to form a symmetric Y using a mirror. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space switches selection. RULE: Mirror reflections must perfectly overlap the target outline. TRAP: Assuming pieces need vertical movement; they only shifted horizontally.

GOAL: Reach the top-left exit while navigating a grid of walls and enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step in that direction. RULE: You destroy enemy robots by approaching them from the side or back, but touching their front is fatal. TRAP: Assuming you can pass through enemy lanes freely; timing your entry into the bottom row was crucial to avoid head-on collisions.

GOAL: Reach the top-left corner while avoiding moving enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; enemies slide until hitting walls. RULE: Destroy enemies by approaching from behind; frontal attacks are fatal. TRAP: Assuming enemies stop when hitting the player causes crashes; they only stop at walls.

GOAL: Align mirrors and piece to create a specific reflection pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object. Space cycles selection between horizontal mirror, vertical mirror, and piece. RULE: Reflections update instantly based on current mirror positions. Moving mirrors before the piece prevents complex trajectory calculations. TRAP: Believing the piece must be moved first. Moving mirrors last risks misalignment if the piece blocks the view or movement path.

GOAL: Guide the bead through a specific path of three waypoints. CONTROLS: Click a diamond to slide it one space; the bead moves based on their collective position. RULE: To shift the bead a long distance, all three diamonds must move together to maintain the necessary vector sum. TRAP: Thinking you can save time by moving only two diamonds; the bead stalls until the third joins the cluster.

GOAL: Extend colored bars to align dots with target markers. CONTROLS: Click a bar to lengthen it; click again to shrink it back. RULE: Bars grow from the tip, pushing the attached handle along a fixed track. TRAP: Assuming the handle stays fixed; it actually moves, blocking other bars if ignored.

GOAL: Move the yellow key to its matching window. CONTROLS: Click rows to shift weight between adjacent panels, changing their heights. RULE: A panel must reach a specific height for its colored block to align with the target. TRAP: Trying to adjust all panels simultaneously; fix the key panel's height first before worrying about the others.

GOAL: Rotate four glyph slots to match target families using minimal presses. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; pressing an arrow also rotates the selected glyph. RULE: Glyphs cycle through a fixed sequence; match the shape family, not exact rotation. TRAP: Assuming rotation mattered forced extra turns; only the base shape counts for completion.

GOAL: Mate all colored shapes by connecting their matching prongs and tabs to clear the board. CONTROLS: Click to select a shape, then use arrow keys to slide it across the grid. RULE: Shapes lock together when their specific geometric features align perfectly, preventing further movement. TRAP: Assuming you can slide a shape through an already mated connection to reach a distant target.

GOAL: Align mirrors to reflect light into the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected pieces; Space switches between mirrors and shapes. RULE: Reflections must hit the target from the correct angle and distance. TRAP: Moving pieces before mirrors causes overlapping reflections that miss the target.

GOAL: Move the keyhole from block A to the target marker on block B. CONTROLS: Click arrows to adjust block widths; click glowing windows to transfer the keyhole between adjacent blocks. RULE: A window activates only when the keyhole’s block aligns perfectly with the window’s edge on both connected blocks. TRAP: Assuming the keyhole stays put during width adjustments; it actually slides with the block’s edge, requiring precise width changes to reach the target.

GOAL: Match the blue glyph sequence to the hidden target order derived from the yellow row's structure. CONTROLS: Arrows navigate the cursor; Up and Down adjust the width of the blue glyphs under the cursor. RULE: The blue row is the only editable row; the yellow row remains fixed as a reference map. TRAP: Assuming both rows change together or that the width bar counts every input action wasted valuable exploration time.

GOAL: Align colored bars to target lengths by sliding them into matching slots. CONTROLS: Click bars to slide them horizontally or vertically into position. RULE: Each bar’s length must exactly match the gap width of its destination slot. TRAP: Assuming brackets are part of the bar body; they are decorative markers, not adjustable segments.

ESTABLISHED: The red enemy mirrors your moves with a four-turn delay, turning lefts into rights and ups into downs. FAILED: Trying to run straight down the top corridor results in instant death as the delayed mirror move intercepts you. GOAL IS NOT: A simple pathfinding puzzle; it is a timing trap requiring you to manipulate the enemy's position before entering. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move you. Your actions dictate the enemy's future path after a four-step lag, so plan ahead.

GOAL: Match the editable row to the hidden target by linking glyphs through a two-step color chain. CONTROLS: Use arrows to move the cursor and cycle through glyph options in the editable row. RULE: Each glyph connects to the next via a shared intermediate color, forming a strict, unique path. TRAP: Assuming the clue row is editable wastes moves; verify which row changes before committing to a solution.

GOAL: Guide two shapes to color specific dot grids. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; the other waits. RULE: A shape only changes color when fully centered on a matching block. TRAP: Passing over a block does not paint; only the final resting spot counts.

GOAL: Align glyph pairs by cycling boxes until sizes match the target color families. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor between boxes; Down cycles glyphs within the current box. RULE: Each box’s glyphs must match the target list position-by-position, verified by pixel size and shape. TRAP: Assuming pixel size alone confirms a match; shape mismatch caused wasted cycles on false positives.

GOAL: Adjust four colored bars to specific target lengths using a strict move limit. CONTROLS: Clicking a bar increases its size; clicking again or via modifier decreases it. RULE: Each bar has a fixed starting point, so length is determined solely by expansion steps. TRAP: Assuming bars shift position when resized; they only extend or retract from a static anchor.

ESTABLISHED: The green is in the bottom-left room. A blue switch solidifies a barrier, allowing access to a purple stub. The purple checkerboard grating blocks all other paths. FAILED: Trying to cross the purple grating. Trying to reach the yellow block directly. Clicking switches while off the stub. GOAL IS NOT: The yellow block. Just standing in the bottom-left room. CONTROLS: Click switches to change barriers. Arrow keys move the green block.

ESTABLISHED: Swapping block colors places them in the swapped slots. Moving a block into a red block's position swaps them. FAILED: Blindly swapping without checking positions causes misalignment. Moving the wide block into the narrow slot fails. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing all blocks in any red slot. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected block. Clicking a block selects it. Space confirms the level when complete.

GOAL: Guide the blue block into the catcher slot and park it. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active block; clicks swap it with a red block. RULE: Only a swap can place a red block into a fixed target slot. TRAP: Moving the blue block to a red's position does not count as a swap.

ESTABLISHED: Bar drains 2 per move. Refills reset to 42. Revisiting spots rotates the legend. Yellow items restore the bar. FAILED: Moving without monitoring the drain rate. Assuming no-ops are free. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the exit. It requires rotating the legend three times before docking. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. Stepping onto yellow items refills the bar. Stepping onto specific spots rotates the legend.

GOAL: Match the shown pattern using clicks. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle them; arrows move the plunger. RULE: Success requires replicating the specific grid layout exactly. TRAP: Ignoring the plunger’s position limits and overcomplicating the pattern match.

GOAL: Compress the plunger tip fully into the handle to clear the level. CONTROLS: Clicks toggled grid cells to form a diamond shape; arrows moved the tip. RULE: Only an exact diamond pattern shrinks the tip, allowing further leftward movement. TRAP: Assuming any green grid helps; the tip only shrinks when the pattern perfectly matches the target shape.

ESTABLISHED: Two machines exist; right screen holds yellow blocks, left screen shows a small notch-left shape. Both gray output trays connect to the left panel. FAILED: Moving right-screen blocks off the left edge vanishes them without visibly altering the left screen or transferring the piece. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the right screen to the left screen’s static image, nor using the trays as simple sinks. CONTROLS: Buttons toggle block states; directional inputs shift the right piece; clicking left panel glyphs currently yields no visible change.

ESTABLISHED: Two movable pieces, two mirrors, and a fixed yellow target pattern exist. Mirrors create charcoal reflections of current piece positions. FAILED: Moving mirrors to various coordinates and repositioning pieces to align reflections with the yellow pattern has not triggered a win. GOAL IS NOT: Simply aligning current reflections with the yellow shape, nor matching the yellow to static piece bodies alone. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move pieces or mirrors; specific combinations adjust mirror orientation; Enter confirms moves.

GOAL: Fill the canvas purple, then paint the top rows white to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the frame’s position and orientation; clicks select paint colors; space applies the paint. RULE: The frame’s opening faces the direction it rolls, sweeping color across the canvas like a paint roller. TRAP: Thinking the frame rolls in a fixed direction regardless of rotation; it actually moves relative to its current orientation.

GOAL: Slide a single block to the bottom-right corner of the left room. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block horizontally or vertically until it hits a wall. RULE: The block stops only when blocked, so plan paths using the room's narrow bottom corridor. TRAP: Thinking you can stop the block mid-slide; it always travels to the far wall, causing overshoots.

ESTABLISHED: A 4x4 mass on the circle wins; gray circle color does not block victory, but losing mass via zap causes failure. FAILED: Assuming gray indicators prevent winning; relying on static invasion models; executing blind multi-click plans without verifying invader positions. GOAL IS NOT: A yellow 4x4 specifically; the goal matches the current circle color, meaning gray accepts gray results. CONTROLS: Clicks move or merge objects; invaders chase nearest objects within range eight; zapping reduces mass; inspecting state is free.

GOAL: Position the ball inside the right ring and the paddle inside the left ring. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active object; clicking a dot swaps control between the ball and paddle. RULE: Only the currently selected object responds to movement commands. TRAP: Assuming arrows always move the paddle; ignoring the click-to-switch mechanic causes wasted moves.

GOAL: Guide the duck through a blocked shaft to reach the pink cross. CONTROLS: Arrows move the duck; clicking dissolves rock blocks. RULE: Destroying a block clears its surrounding frame, creating a wide passage. TRAP: Thinking only the center needed clearing; the side frames also blocked the path.

ESTABLISHED: The orange entity fills the bottom-left slots first. Your drop path to the bottom-right slot is clear of collisions. FAILED: Moving directly to the bottom-left slot wastes moves and leaves no cheap exit for the final box. GOAL IS NOT: Filling every slot yourself; the orange entity handles the left side if you yield space. CONTROLS: DOWN moves forward, LEFT moves sideways, UP moves backward, SPACE drops the box.

ESTABLISHED: The top bar grows with each move, acting as a step counter. Pegs are 3x7 grid; pipe is bottom-right. FAILED: Jumping over the edge peg into the pipe is rejected. The step counter does not decrease. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the pipe exit or exhausting the step budget. CONTROLS: Click to select a peg; click a destination to move or jump.

GOAL: Move two blocks safely to the bottom gaps while avoiding the central red hazard band. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously in the same direction. RULE: Blocks slide until hitting a wall or another block, not just one step. TRAP: Assuming background areas are safe; they are solid walls, not open space.

GOAL: Fill the grid with specific diagonal color bands. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the paint pose, clicks select colors, space applies the brush. RULE: Later strokes overwrite earlier ones, so you must paint the background first, then the foreground. TRAP: Assuming order didn't matter led to wasted moves fixing overwritten sections.

GOAL: Attach a block, carry it to the container, and drop it inside. CONTROLS: Arrows move and rotate; Space attaches or drops blocks. RULE: Carry the block overhead to the slot, then drop it into the container. TRAP: Assuming you can slide the block sideways while carrying; you must align vertically before dropping.

GOAL: Move the X and diamond shapes to cover specific colored dots without overlapping other blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; the spacebar switches control between the X and the diamond. RULE: Shapes must cover their matching colored dots completely to turn those dots off. TRAP: Moving the X first uncovered top dots, assuming they were safe; they were not, requiring a second trip to re-cover them.

GOAL: Position two pieces at specific targets using rotating mirrors to reflect their paths. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece or mirror; Space cycles which mirror is currently selected. RULE: Pieces bounce off mirrors; you must align mirror centers to create exact reflection angles for each piece. TRAP: Thinking mirrors stay fixed; they shift with arrow presses, so adjust center positions before cycling to the next piece.

GOAL: Clear the board by leaving exactly one peg. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the plug; clicking selected a peg and its target landing spot. RULE: The plug carried the attached peg along the entire path to the jump site. TRAP: Believing the peg stayed fixed while the plug moved through the maze.

GOAL: Paint the grid to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click to paint, arrows to rotate brush, space to stamp. RULE: One brush covers all cells where row plus column equals nine. TRAP: Thinking the orange patch needs separate work; the main brush covers it if you wait.

GOAL: Paint specific canvas regions with four colors to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the stamp pose; clicking a color loads it; clicking the stamp applies it. RULE: Rotating the canvas rotates the stamp's orientation and position relative to the frame. TRAP: Assuming the stamp stays fixed while the canvas rotates, causing misplaced paint.

GOAL: Navigate to the yellow zone using the rotating red arm as a bridge. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character; clicking the plug rotates the arm between horizontal and vertical. RULE: You must stand on the purple safe zone to toggle the arm, ensuring it aligns with your path. TRAP: Moving while the arm is horizontal blocks your path; rotate it to vertical first to cross the gap.

GOAL: Remove the cork to let the block settle into the plunger mechanism. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; clicking pumps the plunger. RULE: Destroying the water drop first allows the block to push the cork into the handle, clearing the path. TRAP: Trying to push the block onto the cork before removing the drop fails, as the cork remains rigid and blocks progress.

GOAL: Match the target pattern by covering specific spots with blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block; it lands on matching colors to fill them. RULE: You must cover exactly the required spots without overlapping or missing any. TRAP: Thinking you can ignore empty spaces; every blank spot must remain uncovered to match the target pattern.

GOAL: Slide three colored blocks into their matching outline shapes to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected block; clicks select which block to move. RULE: Moving a block into another pushes it; it slides until hitting a wall or outline. TRAP: Sliding stops only when the next step is blocked, so ending inside an outline is allowed.

GOAL: Move two small blocks to safe spots, then slide a pair to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected block; clicking selects a block or deselects by clicking a wall. RULE: Only the selected block moves, so park helpers out of the way before solving the main pair. TRAP: Assuming all blocks move together wastes time; you must individually park each small block to clear the path.

GOAL: Guide the echo to the socket to retract the plug, then walk through the open door to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the player and recorded steps; Space switched between recording and playback modes. RULE: The echo replays recorded moves until it hits a wall or completes the sequence. TRAP: Believing the echo stops only when blocked; it actually halts when the recorded steps run out.

GOAL: Push the piston block fully against the handle to expel the dose. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piston block; clicks activated the cork seal. RULE: The piston must travel through the open passage created by removing the cork. TRAP: Assuming the green mark was a target stop; it was merely a graduation line.

GOAL: Move the green block into the small ring while clearing the path with the yellow shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; blocking the yellow shape pushes it away. RULE: The green block fits the ring only when the yellow shape is fully cleared from that zone. TRAP: Assuming you can slide past the yellow shape; it acts as a solid wall until pushed aside.

GOAL: Reach the exit while managing ghost collisions. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character and spawn a repeating echo. RULE: Your echo replays your past moves, so you must avoid its path. TRAP: Believing you can move straight to the goal; early deviations were needed to dodge the echo.
